goal: Resolve remaining packet closure and preflight regressions in issue #179
asset: Static packet input closure and existing specification checks

record.question: How should decisions and requirements constrain implementation?

options.strongest_objection: Adds a manifest and lock that must be revised when requirements change
The existing compiler accepts mutating graphs with no spec or decisions
Would require new models and checker support for every implementation language

record.rationale: Retain diagnostic compatibility while making judged snapshot checks strict; use frozen closure in the Stop hook and one memoized expansion in full closure queries. Report opaque loaders and planned ambient files before edits.
evidence: Read #179 reproductions and packet_inputs.py, specification.py, lib.sh and the scaffolded harness.

costs.cost: Two tracked artifacts and requirement-specific check maintenance
evidence: Design scope; no elapsed implementation time estimate claimed

costs.cost: No new runtime checks; unmet requirements can remain invisible
evidence: Mutating graph without spec compiled with exit 0

costs.cost: Per-language proof and conformance work with unmeasured maintenance cost
evidence: Existing proof integrations have different semantics; no universal adapter exists in this repository

requirements.statement: Frozen trust paths avoid live expansion; closure records expand once; project files and regex filters remain lockable; strict harness checks refuse drift in judged worktrees; opaque loaders warn; planned ambient files conflict with descendant locked inputs.
requirements.counterexample: A worktree modifies a locked helper and remains strict-green, or a green Stop repeats the whole live closure walk.

checks.scope: Exercise tracked support closure, live drift, planned locked edits and reachability
assumptions: These local fixtures exercise the real helper and emitted JavaScript paths without authenticating a production Workflow or provisioning external CI identities

challenges.claim: Static closure cannot discover all dynamic inputs
challenges.resolution: Warn at known opaque loaders and retain explicit harnessInputs for dynamic resources.
